literal.prompt: Какое мелкое ракообразное служит важнейшей пищей для многих китов, тюленей и пингвинов Антарктики?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The stem asks for a small crustacean eaten by Antarctic whales, seals and penguins. AAP identifies krill as zooplankton and an important food species (L310, L326), says krill feeds penguins, some seals and baleen whales (L312, L332), and identifies squid as a cephalopod and prey (L312-L313). The fish page identifies Antarctic silverfish and icefish (L299-L304). Thus krill is the only crustacean among these options and matches the food role.
literalGroups.locator: AAP Antarctic food web full captured body L308-L334; L310, L312-L313, L326-L332.

literalGroups.literal: Антарктический криль питается фитопланктоном, а сам служит пищей для рыб, кальмаров, пингвинов, некоторых тюленей и усатых китов. Так он связывает микроскопические растения с крупными животными пищевой сети.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AAP states phytoplankton feeds krill (L310, L326), while krill feeds fish, squid, penguins, some seals and baleen whales (L312, L330-L332). This directly supports both energy-transfer sentences and the “some seals” qualifier.

literalGroups.literal: Кальмары — головоногие; ими питаются многие виды в Антарктике.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AAP calls squid a cephalopod (L312) and says it is prey for many species (L313). The note identifies this plausible Antarctic food-web distractor and adds a fact about squid itself.

literalGroups.primaryGround: AAP identifies Antarctic silverfish within its Antarctic fish page (L297-L301). The proposed wording states its fish class and Southern Ocean setting without the unsupported emphasis “важная”.

literalGroups.literal: Ледяные рыбы приспособлены к холодной воде и занимают заметное место в пищевой сети Южного океана.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AAP says Antarctic fish are adapted to cold (L299) and icefish eat plankton and small fish and feed seabirds, seals and large fish (L309-L310). This is specific to the icefish distractor.

literalGroups.literal: Антарктический криль — небольшое ракообразное; взрослая особь достигает около 6 см и весит более 1 г.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AAP calls krill an important Antarctic food species (L326, L332) and states adult Antarctic krill are about 6 cm and weigh over 1 g (L327). The adult size/weight is beyond prompt and keyed answer.
